scope: Independent mathematical audit of exact expected-link formula (4.1), inverse-fixed deletion, fixed-alphabet uniform endpoint asymptotics, all three length residues, degree growth (4.3), exact endpoint compression and tensor spectra (5.1)-(5.2).
completion_refers_to: This assigned counting/spectral verification audit only.
analytical_findings: The oriented incidence coefficients and exact remaining-block completion count give (4.1) without conditioning on retention.
Odd inverse-fixed deletion is O(lambda^((t-1)/2)); even inverse-fixed words do not exist. Positive fixed Perron coordinates make the endpoint relative errors uniformly exponential.
Class-size and complementary-block exponent factors cancel for unequal lengths, giving the claimed degree scale and Q tensor P tensor R limit.
Endpoint compression is exact and reversible; its limiting stationary weights are (h_t/6) r_a^2 r_b^2.
Unequal residues have nonprincipal positive tensor products up to rho/2, strictly below one half for each fixed alphabet.
All three residues and both parities of L are covered by the uniform exponential estimates.
boundaries: The fixed-alphabet quantifier is essential; no uniform margin over varying alphabet sizes is established.
The candidate excludes two factors. The official arXiv Question 1.9 includes them; OWR n>=3 target matching is reserved to the parent scope audit.
